About

I’m a Film, Sound & Video student at Ngee Ann Polytechnic, and I already work as a photographer and videographer on aviation shoots and short-form client content.

I care about lighting, sound design and the small details that make a story land in the edit. I work well in teams, plan carefully before a shoot and deliver on time.

Education: Diploma in Film, Sound & Video, Ngee Ann Polytechnic (2025 to present). O-Level certificate, Woodlands Ring Secondary School (2024).
